prior_failure_rows.addressed_by: The canary removes the retired scheduler dependency, owns sequential leases and teardown, and emits first-token plus monotonic phase evidence instead of a gate-only admission artifact.

The corpus consumes a completed task-owned exact stream, uses proof-carrying rows rather than the retired planning chain, and defines readiness by attributable completion rather than accuracy.
The new task has a present dual-encoding corpus, family-disjoint rows, and an explicit pre-oracle feature denylist instead of reading a missing proposal artifact.
The new corpus supplies at least 24 frozen exact-invalid parseable units, and localization is gated on a fresh held-family leak-free diagnostic signal rather than the old two-row headroom count.

The fixture owns a fresh exact chronological stream and delayed-commit ABI, removes the failed exact-slot dependency, and tests read-only episodes plus atomic restart and inverse-patch rollback directly.

The upstream transactional fixture is present and independently runnable, and the comparison uses controlled prospective orders with support and transfer metrics instead of the missing online-energy fixture.
The audit now has an exact completion gate, all six prospective order rows, immutable snapshots, and commit receipts; it remains cold and refuses to repair missing evidence.
